Record Class OrderStatusEvent.OrderRecord

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
app.order.event.OrderStatusEvent.OrderRecord
Record Components:
clientReference - the idempotency key the client submitted the order under
instrumentId - the instrument's id
instrumentName - the instrument's display name
indicativePrice - the price the client saw when submitting
bufferPercent - the price tolerance the order was submitted with
submittedAt - when the order was received
acceptedAt - when the trading rules passed, or null
resolvedAt - when the order was filled or rejected, or null
simulatedAt - the replay time the client traded at, or null
executionType - persisted executionType
limitPrice - persisted limitPrice
stopPrice - persisted stopPrice
referencePrice - persisted referencePrice
referenceAt - persisted referenceAt
sessionId - persisted sessionId
triggeredAt - persisted triggeredAt
triggerPrice - authoritative activation quote, null before triggering or for legacy orders
evaluatedAt - persisted evaluatedAt
reservedCash - persisted reservedCash
reservedShares - persisted reservedShares
executionPrice - persisted executionPrice
rejectionCode - persisted rejectionCode
Enclosing class:
OrderStatusEvent
public static record OrderStatusEvent.OrderRecord(UUID clientReference, Integer instrumentId, String instrumentName, BigDecimal indicativePrice, BigDecimal bufferPercent, OffsetDateTime submittedAt, OffsetDateTime acceptedAt, OffsetDateTime resolvedAt, OffsetDateTime simulatedAt, String executionType, BigDecimal limitPrice, BigDecimal stopPrice, BigDecimal referencePrice, OffsetDateTime referenceAt, Long sessionId, OffsetDateTime triggeredAt, BigDecimal triggerPrice, OffsetDateTime evaluatedAt, BigDecimal reservedCash, BigDecimal reservedShares, BigDecimal executionPrice, String rejectionCode) extends Record
The order row behind a status change: what a consumer without access to the orders table needs to show the order.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
